description: Audit spacing in a stylesheet. Pass `css` (free) or a public `url` (Pro). Reads margin, padding and gap properties (shorthands split into their parts; rem and em converted with the root size the CSS sets; auto and 0 skipped), then reports the detected base unit (8 if 85% of uses fit, else 4, else none with the best fit), the number of distinct values against a budget of 12, off-grid values with counts, gaps between steps, values used once, the split between margin, padding and gap, and a proposed scale with an old-to-new table. Percent, vw, calc() and clamp() values are counted as fluid and left out of the scale.

css.description: CSS text to read (a stylesheet, or several concatenated). Free up to 100,000 characters; Pro up to 2,000,000.

url.description: Pro only. Public page whose linked and inline stylesheets are fetched (up to 12 sheets, 5 MB).

name: audit_spacing
title: Spacing audit
